findings.evidence: Its coefficientwise proof uses no subtraction; Mathlib/RingTheory/MvPowerSeries/Trunc.lean:318 defines truncTotal under CommSemiring, as does MvPolynomial's homogeneousComponent.
findings.fix: State this lemma under [CommSemiring R], separately from the substitution section.
findings.issue: coe_homogeneousComponent_truncTotal unnecessarily requires CommRing R, excluding semiring coefficients.

findings.evidence: The nearby homogeneousComponent_subst_of_le_order already supports R → S; Mathlib's le_order_subst at Substitution.lean:507 also supports different coefficient rings. Both new proofs merely specialize these general results.
findings.fix: Generalize both to [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S], with a valued in MvPowerSeries τ S and l valued in MvPolynomial τ S.
findings.issue: homogeneousComponent_subst_eq_aeval and order_le_order_subst restrict substitution to the same coefficient ring, excluding substitutions along an algebra map.

summary: Two supporting APIs have unnecessarily restrictive coefficient assumptions.
